title: Everyday Phrases — A Physiotherapy Session
title_quote: Good morning. Do you have an appointment?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧑‍⚕️ 實用「物理治療」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Physiotherapy Session
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「物理治療」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是治療師：做物理治療：先跟治療師說哪裡痛、受傷的經過，做幾個評估動作找出痛點，熱敷與電療之後學幾個居家伸展，約好下次時間、拿了衛教單，叮嚀不要久坐。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'A Physiotherapy Session' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A physiotherapy session: describing the pain, going through the assessment, heat and electrical therapy, learning home stretches, and booking the next appointment. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning. Do you have an appointment?
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ. du ju hæv ən əˈpɔɪntmənt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at three o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please take a seat over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you. It is busy today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What brings you here today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My right shoulder really hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shoulder is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The right one, near my neck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you lift your arm for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd juː lɪft jɔːr ɑːrm fɔːr miː?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以為我把手臂抬起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can lift it a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you hurt your shoulder?
dialogue.zh: 你的肩膀是怎麼受傷的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fell off my bike.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did the pain start?
dialogue.zh: 疼痛是什麼時候開始的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It started last Friday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you go to a doctor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw one at the clinic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did the doctor tell you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing is broken, she said.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So she sent you to therapy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she gave me a note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now show me where it hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hurts right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you move?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it hurts a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long has it been sore?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has been sore three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were you lifting anything heavy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was moving some furniture.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel tingling in your fingers?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fil ˈtɪŋɡəlɪŋ ɪn jʊr ˈfɪŋɡɚz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just a dull ache.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your neck also stiff?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I cannot turn it left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fall on your arm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That time I landed on my elbow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt taɪm aɪ ˈlændɪd ɔn maɪ ˈɛlboʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you had this pain before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this is my first time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you taking any medications now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only vitamins for my health.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How well do you sleep these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɛl du ju slip ðiz deɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pain wakes me up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sit at a desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly I sit at a computer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other injuries in the past?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Years ago I broke my wrist.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the shoulder worse in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈʃoʊldər wɜrs ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, it is very stiff then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pain travel down your arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə pen ˈtrævəl daʊn jʊr ɑrm?/
dialogue.zh: 疼痛會往手臂下方延伸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes it reaches my elbow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know enough for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju. aɪ noʊ ɪˈnʌf fɚ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。我現在了解得夠多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we can start the assessment.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們可以開始評估了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I see your referral note?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看一下你的轉診單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, all signed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your insurance card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is inside my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you point to the exact spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd juː pɔɪnt tuː ði ɪɡˈzækt spɑːt?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以指出確切的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just under this bone here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How would you describe the pain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp and hot, like fire.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you press it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt hɜrt wɛn ju prɛs ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That hurts, so press gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pain constant or not?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comes and goes all day long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What makes the pain feel better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest and a warm shower help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What makes it worse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reaching up makes it much worse.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were you alone when you fell?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my friend was with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hit your head?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, nothing hit my head.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you lose consciousness then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, I stayed awake the whole time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ, aɪ steɪd əˈweɪk ðə hoʊl taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which hand do you write with?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly my right hand these days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you playing any sports now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swimming twice a week, usually.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has your sleep changed since the fall?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz jʊr slip tʃeɪndʒd sɪns ðə fɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 跌倒之後睡眠有改變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep is broken most nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any numbness in your fingers now?
dialogue.zh: 現在手指有麻的感覺嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only sore muscles, no numbness.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you tell me about the accident?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd juː tɛl miː əˈbaʊt ði ˈæksɪdənt?/
dialogue.zh: 可以跟我說說發生的經過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fell off my bike at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɛl ɔf maɪ baɪk æt nun/
dialogue.zh: 我中午從腳踏車摔下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did the pain start hurting?
dialogue.zh: 疼痛是什麼時候開始痛的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next morning it started.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pain bad today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today it is a little better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How bad is it on a scale?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bæd ɪz ɪt ɑːn ə skeɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 如果用分數算，痛的程度是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe six out of ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the fall long ago?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It started last Friday, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you put ice on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice helped for a short while.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you dress yourself easily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shirts are difficult now, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you sleeping on that side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I sleep on my back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a heavy bag bother you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My laptop bag is heavy, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright. Let me note all this down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈraɪt. lɛt mi noʊt ɔl ðɪs daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, take your time, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you raise your right arm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it feels stiff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now move your arm to the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ muv jʊr ɑrm tu ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hurts when I go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it hurt near the shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pain is right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please turn your arm slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turning is harder than lifting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you touch your other shoulder?
dialogue.zh: 你可以摸到另一邊肩膀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can only reach halfway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which movement hurts the most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lifting my arm above my head.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me press here gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That spot is very tender.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How strong is the pain now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about a five today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this press feel sharp?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it feels more like pressure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you lift your arm forward?
dialogue.zh: 你可以往前抬起手臂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me when it starts hurting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hurts right about there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the pain exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just under the bony part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pain deep or shallow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels quite deep inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try to relax your shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am trying to relax it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel this small tap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I feel it clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please push your arm against me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pushing does not hurt at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now pull your arm back gently.
dialogue.zh: 現在輕輕把手臂拉回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pulling is a little uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which angle is the worst?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When my arm goes straight up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that angle always hurt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when I lift it high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far can you lift it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only up to my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the other side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left side feels fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you shrug your shoulders?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shrugging hurts a little bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you breathe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, breathing is completely fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now relax and let me press.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that press hurt you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one was sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you show me that angle again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl juː ʃoʊ miː ðæt ˈæŋɡəl əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 可以再做一次那個角度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it hurts right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which direction is the hardest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lifting my arm straight up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high can you go today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little past my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it stop you at one point?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt stɑp ju æt wʌn pɔɪnt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, something blocks the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hold your arm right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holding it here is painful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pain sharp or dull?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is sharp at that angle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does rest make it better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, resting helps a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you rotate your arm inward?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inward is easier than outward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now rotate it outward slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outward brings a sharp pain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which motion should we avoid?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Avoid lifting your arm overhead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me test your strength now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在測一下你的力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arm feels weak today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push against my hand here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That push feels a bit weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the weakness new for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It started a few days ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pain wake you at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə peɪn weɪk ju æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 痛會讓你在夜裡醒來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes it wakes me up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just lie down on the table.
dialogue.zh: 直接躺在治療床上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can lie down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now lift your arm off the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɪft jʊr ɑrm ɔf ðə ˈteɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That angle hurts very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does it hurt the most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right at the top of my shoulder.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt æt ðə tɑp əv maɪ ˈʃoʊldər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pain go down your arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə peɪn ɡoʊ daʊn jʊr ɑrm?/
dialogue.zh: 疼痛會往下延伸到手臂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sometimes it does.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel my fingers here?
dialogue.zh: 你感覺得到我的手指在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your touch is very light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me if this is too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ɪf ðɪs ɪz tu mʌtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine, please continue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now press your arm down slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pressing down is not painful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which angle should I write down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write down the straight upward one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it hurt more in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt hɜrt mɔr ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mornings are the worst.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pain better after moving?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, after moving around.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to stop here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that angle is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the heat pack warm enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels nice and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you comfortable with the heat pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈkʌmfərtəbəl wɪð ðə hit pæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels very relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should the heat stay on?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd ðə hit steɪ ɔn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it on for twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you feel the heat most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju fil ðə hit moʊst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly around my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the towel under the pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə ˈtaʊəl ˈʌndər ðə pæk?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼熱敷包下面要墊毛巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The towel protects your bare skin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a deep breath and relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That feels better already, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I move my arm a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ muv maɪ ɑrm ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以稍微動一下手臂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep it very still.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the heat too strong for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hit tu strɔŋ fɔr ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the warmth feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer will ring very soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait for the timer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us begin the electrical treatment.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs bɪˈɡɪn ði ɪˈlɛktrɪkəl ˈtritmənt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready for that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you had a TENS unit before?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju hæd ə tɛnz ˈjunɪt bɪˈfɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I have never had this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pulsing feel strange to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈpʌlsɪŋ fil streɪndʒ tu ju?/
dialogue.zh: 這種跳動感覺得奇怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like tiny gentle taps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I place these sticky pads?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ pleɪs ðiz ˈstɪki pædz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, beside your sore muscle.
dialogue.zh: 就貼在這裡，痠痛肌肉旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How strong should the current be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong enough to feel a tingle.
dialogue.zh: 強到有一點刺刺的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I will slowly increase the level.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ wɪl ˈsloʊli ɪnˈkris ðə ˈlɛvəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I allowed to move my arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ əˈlaʊd tu muv maɪ ɑrm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but try to stay relaxed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me if anything feels uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 如果有任何不舒服就告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is comfortable, so no problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the pads be removed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After the machine finishes its cycle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your shoulder feel looser?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that stiffness is slowly fading.
dialogue.zh: 有，那種僵硬慢慢消退了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After this, I will teach you stretches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðɪs aɪ wɪl titʃ ju ˈstrɛtʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 接下來我教你幾個伸展。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I want to learn them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heat pad is coming off now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hit pæd ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ɔf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 熱敷墊現在要拿下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my shoulder feels better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us start your home stretches.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs stɑrt jʊr hoʊm ˈstrɛtʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 現在開始你的居家伸展。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am ready to begin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift your arm up to the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft jʊr ɑrm ʌp tu ðə frʌnt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, is that correct?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold your arm there five seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lower it slowly and then repeat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alright, I will do it again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now bend your elbow and hold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arm already feels a stretch.
dialogue.zh: 我的手臂已經有拉伸感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your elbow close to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my elbow is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel any sharp pain?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only a gentle pulling feeling.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有輕輕拉扯的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep breathing while you stretch.
dialogue.zh: 伸展的時候要持續呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am trying to breathe slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let your arm relax down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That feels much easier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try that stretch on the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðæt strɛtʃ ɑːn ði ˈʌðər saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 換另一邊做同樣的伸展。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alright, I will switch sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now roll your shoulder gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This stretch reaches my shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 這個伸展拉到我的肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull your arm across your chest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, the shoulder feels tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe out as you pull back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps me relax more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the muscle stretch, not bounce.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep the movement slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now hold that position for thirty seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hoʊld ðæt pəˈzɪʃən fɔr ˈθɜrti ˈsɛkəndz./
dialogue.zh: 現在維持這個姿勢三十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty seconds seems quite long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep holding, you are almost done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I can hold it longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the same on your left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ðə seɪm ɑːn jɔːr lɛft saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alright, my left side feels tighter.
dialogue.zh: 好，我的左邊感覺比較緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the stretch too painful for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə strɛtʃ tu ˈpenfəl fɔr ju?/
dialogue.zh: 這個伸展對你來說太痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is only slightly sore.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Repeat this stretch three times daily.
dialogue.zh: 這個伸展每天重複三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times every day, understood.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your movements slow and smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not rush the stretch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the stretch hurt your shoulder?
dialogue.zh: 這個伸展會讓肩膀痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my shoulder feels fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now show me your seated stretch.
dialogue.zh: 現在做你坐著的伸展給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, with my arm up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reach up the wall, but slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shoulder is opening up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop when you feel strong tension.
dialogue.zh: 感覺很緊繃時就停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, I will stop there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many seconds should I hold it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈsɛkəndz ʃʊd aɪ hoʊld ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it for about twenty seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these stretches hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 這些伸展會讓手臂痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my arm feels fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now stretch your neck to the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ strɛtʃ jʊr nɛk tu ðə saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 現在把脖子往側邊伸展。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one feels really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your shoulder down while turning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my shoulder is down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did those stretches very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, they feel helpful.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，它們感覺很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I come back next?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back next Tuesday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Tuesday morning still open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Tuesday morning is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we book the same room?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以訂同一間房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will use the same room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will each visit take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each visit takes about one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring anything along?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please bring your insurance card again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number should I call?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the number on the slip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I write my name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write your name at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I confirm the Tuesday visit?
dialogue.zh: 我要確認星期二的療程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have you down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the morning better than afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning is better for your shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 早上對你的肩膀比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will I see next time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will see the same therapist.
dialogue.zh: 你會見到同一位治療師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I come early next time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come ten minutes early, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we meet twice a week?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du wi mit twaɪs ə wik?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼我們一週見兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a week helps your shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次對你的肩膀有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the education sheet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The education sheet is right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please explain the sheet to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will explain the whole sheet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do every morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do the stretches every morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times should I repeat this?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz ʃʊd aɪ rɪˈpit ðɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repeat each stretch ten times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sheet in Chinese too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both sides are in Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is taking a photo allowed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a photo, that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the sheet list the exercises?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists all the home exercises.
dialogue.zh: 上面列出所有居家運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stop if it hurts?
dialogue.zh: 如果會痛我該停下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop right away if it hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is sitting so bad for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ˈsɪtɪŋ soʊ bæd fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼久坐對我這麼不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting still tightens your shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often should I stand up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand up every thirty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 每三十分鐘站起來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I still work at my desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ stɪl wɜːrk æt maɪ dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 我還能在書桌前工作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can work at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a soft chair bad for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə sɔft tʃɛr bæd fɔr mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a soft chair is bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I put a pillow here?
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡放個枕頭好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a small pillow behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about long car rides?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop and walk during car rides.
dialogue.zh: 開車途中要停下來走走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I set a timer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a timer on your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is walking good for my shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walking is very good for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far should I walk each day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ʃʊd aɪ wɔk itʃ deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk a short distance each day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I park my car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park behind the building, it is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrk bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪt ɪz fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay at the front desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay the total at the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ðə ˈtoʊtəl æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my insurance cover this visit?
dialogue.zh: 我的保險會給付這次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your insurance covers most of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I get a receipt today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your receipt for today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the pain comes back?
dialogue.zh: 如果疼痛又回來怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us if the pain returns.
dialogue.zh: 如果疼痛回來就打給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use heat at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use heat for ten minutes only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is ice better after exercise?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice is better after hard exercise.
dialogue.zh: 激烈運動後冰敷比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do I call about the bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu du aɪ kɔl əˈbaʊt ðə bɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the office about the bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the sheet be ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sheet is ready right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write the date on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote the date at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt ðə deɪt æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep this sheet forever?
dialogue.zh: 這張單子我要一直留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the sheet in a safe place.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ʃit ɪn ə seɪf pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 把單子收在安全的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else should I know?
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼我該知道的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink more water every single day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sleep on my side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep on your side with pillows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pillows do you suggest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pillow under your arm helps.
dialogue.zh: 手臂下墊一個枕頭有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I go back to the gym?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡoʊ bæk tuː ðə dʒɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait two weeks before the gym.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can I do at the gym?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt kæn aɪ du æt ðə dʒɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 在健身房我可以做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with light weights and walking.
dialogue.zh: 先從輕重量和走路開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my shoulder getting better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your shoulder is better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I walk home today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, walk home slowly today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take the bus instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus is fine, but stand often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs ɪz faɪn bʌt stænd ɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 搭公車可以，但要常站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, it feels better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, take care.

issues.note: 問答輕微錯位（minor）：idx 88-89「Was the fall long ago?」/「It started last Friday, I think.」答的是疼痛起始日、不是摔傷遠近。合理化為非 error：b 沿用本段 it（疼痛）的指涉可通，且患者加 I think 屬口語模糊，不致誤解。

時間線軟性張力（minor，非 error）：idx 13「It started last Friday morning.」、idx 81「I fell off my bike at noon.」、idx 83「The next morning it started.」、idx 89「It started last Friday, I think.」——全篇未明說摔傷日期，讀成週四中午摔、週五清晨開始痛（= the next morning）即自洽，與固定事實「上週五起、約三天」一致；只有硬讀成「週五中午摔」才會與 13 相抵。建議日後把摔傷日講死，但目前不需再開一輪。

人稱指涉模糊（minor）：idx 224-225「Where should I place these sticky pads?」/「Right here, beside your sore muscle.」靠聲位彈性可讀成病人問、治療師答（與 idx 168-169「Which motion should we avoid?」/「Avoid lifting your arm overhead.」同型，後者問句自然、無問題）；只是「病人自己放貼片」語意偏弱，b 的 your 指涉的是 a 的身體。屬可理解範圍。
重複度略高（非 error）：起始時間被追問四次（idx 12/24/82/88）、idx 46 與 184 同問手臂放射痛、idx 21/121/151「hurts right here/there」近似、idx 44-45 與 194-195 同問早上更痛、Do you…／Is the… 開頭各十餘次。機器已驗無整句重複；200 對問診循環本就反覆，屬格式固有。

口語省略（非 error）：idx 61「Comes and goes all day long.」省主詞、idx 25「It has been sore three days.」省 for、idx 361「Park behind the building, it is free.」逗號黏接、idx 334-335「Is the sheet in Chinese too?」/「Yes, both sides are in Chinese.」語意略繞；audit 語法／冠詞／標點項已全過，皆屬會話可接受寫法。

review.summary_zh: 本輪七處修正全部落實：95 改「No, I sleep on my back.」、155「A little past my shoulder.」與 139 同高（熱敷後略進步亦合理）、184/185 改問手臂放射並答 Yes（與 46/47 一致）、284 用 seated stretch、316/317 只確認週二不再提改週五、81 壓到 7 詞、336 已無與外題共用的 4-gram；全篇無腿部／下背處方殘留，固定事實（右肩右臂、騎車摔、上週五起約三天、評估按痛、熱敷＋電療、肩部居家伸展、約下次、衛教單、勿久坐）逐項到位，未見 error 級問題，故予 APPROVED。美式 IPA 依機器證據給分（ipa_vote 0 條 SUSPECT、逐詞對齊通過、audit hard=0；視圖無音標列故未自行判讀）。
